memo: Incumbent is now mean_adjusted 1.1077 over 2 runs, after slot 11 was accepted: FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.05 plus the sequence-length curriculum (official 1.1085/1.1068, delta -0.0068). Each part alone was a single-run gain (curriculum -0.0037, FINAL_LR_FRAC -0.0026) and together they were better. Schedule and data changes helped. Architecture changes did not: DEPTH 10 (+0.0008), DEPTH 6 (+0.0082) and SwiGLU (-0.0002) gave no real gain. Hyperparameter tweaks to the optimizer and regularization were neutral or worse: WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 (+0.0024), MATRIX_LR 0.05 (+0.0013), momentum ramp (+0.0000) and lm_head init (-0.0001). EMA was clearly harmful (+0.0971). Next: tune the curriculum (length, shortest sequence), try FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.1, MATRIX_LR below 0.04, and WARMUP_RATIO 0.03 (-0.0010) on top of the incumbent. Replicate any small win, since single-run noise looks similar in size to the deltas. Avoid architecture changes, EMA and no-op edits.
